Education
DTU Chemistry is in charge of the majority of chemistry teaching at DTU. Therefore, many MSc and BSc students will take courses offered by DTU Chemistry during their studies.
In our course offerings, we make sure that theory and hands-on experiments go hand in hand. We offer courses that lay the foundation for your chemistry education early in your studies. We offer advanced courses for chemical engineering students in advanced and applied chemistry - courses that often relate to current research projects at the department within our main areas: physical, inorganic and organic chemistry.
You will find all the information regarding our programmes, what it is like to study in Denmark and more specifically at DTU, and information about when and how to apply by following the link below. We have done our utmost to ensure, that all the information you need about not only the programmes, DTU offers in English, but all the programmes taught in Danish as well has been collected on these pages for your convenience.
Read about study programmes at DTU

PhD Study at DTU Chemistry
The PhD programme at DTU Chemistry is a versatile research programme in modern chemistry with options ranging from basic research to projects in collaboration with industry, as well as innovation that can lead to start-up companies.
PhD Study at DTU Chemistry
Faculty at DTU Chemistry is committed to support the education of future chemists through lectures and supervision.
